# Vectary

Vectary is an online 3D design platform for creative teams and individuals working with real-world products and concepts. It brings together Canvas for AI-accelerated ideation across dimensions, Studio for interactive 3D & AR presentations, and Workspaces for team sharing and embedding 3D content in one connected workflow.People understand products best when they can explore them. Start in Studio with an existing CAD or 3D model, add realistic materials, movement, and interactions, then share through Workspaces as a link, embed, or AR experience on any phone. Or begin in Canvas with sketches, notes, and references, generate ideas and develop concepts with AI across 2D, 3D, and AR, and bring them to life in Studio.Designers, architects, marketers, and creative teams of any size can move from first idea to validated concept faster, all in one place and right in the browser.Built for invention, not just marketing.
